description.narrative:
Upgrade the Philip Goldson Highway between Miles 24.5 to 92, and the Remate Bypass, to increase safety, accessibility, efficiency and resilience; and to improve GOBZ’s capacity for informed decision-making for livelihood enhancement along those corridors.
The Project consists of the following components: (a) Project Preparation assistance (b) Land (c) Infrastructure Works (d) Engineering and construction-related services (e) Other Project Support Services (f) Project Management
